title: rubus rotundior
intro: Rubus rotundior, commonly known as Himalayan Raspberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions such as digestive issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of Rubus rotundior include its ability to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of ongoing research.
